observations.why: Directive establishing a recurring cadence carries energized, forward-looking commitment — the speaker is actively instituting, not merely noting.
Aphoristic warning frames an unrehearsed rollback as a loss — urgency-as-worry delivered through a pointed, memorable antithesis.
Structured cadence label restated as settled fact — low arousal, positive valence of a satisfied arrangement.
Administrative self-attribution in a metadata field — settled, low-arousal acceptance of responsibility.

mints.name: StakeAsAphoristicWarning
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker crystallizing a stake into a memorable warning that makes the cost of inaction feel concrete?
